gameDescriptionHtml:
Stone 4 Souls is a medieval fantasy metroidvania with RPG elements. Explore a world full of secrets and dangers while wielding powerful swords and equipping stunning visual items. Unlock new abilities and level up your character with a skill tree.

In a world that had known 20 years of peace after a great war, the tranquility is brutally interrupted by dark creatures that emerge from dimensional portals, bringing destruction and chaos. Your closest friend has disappeared and you suspect that he may be the key to unraveling the mystery behind these attacks. Explore the world, fight ferocious creatures and discover the truth behind the portals and the approaching darkness. With a unique combination of exploration, combat and customization, Stone 4 Souls offers an exciting and challenging gaming experience. Unlock new skills, upgrade your equipment and face the challenges that lie ahead. Get ready to save the world from darkness and discover the fate of your missing friend. Your journey begins now.

EQUIPMENT: Explore the maps to find chests with unique visual equipment and attributes that can be equipped for each need, assembling your own set.

LEVEL UP: Kill enemies to level up. As you level up, you earn points that can be spent on the skill tree to increase: Life/Strength/Defense/Stamina/Special.

COMBAT: You can use two types of swords: Light swords are faster to execute agile enemies Heavy swords are slower, but cause more damage In the game we have 3 types of specials that use the Limit bar, which can be filled as you hit your enemies. There are also elemental swords that have unique specials.

Game Features

  • Metroidvania/Souslike/Platformer with RPG elements.
  • Medieval fantasy.
  • Many enemies.
  • Changing visual “equipment” armor.
  • Heavy and light swords changing the combat stance.
  • Different specials for light and heavy swords.
  • Many well-developed levels.
  • Immersive combat system with blood.
  • User-friendly interface.
  • Nice and engaging graphics.
  • Excellent soundtracks.
